page.layout: One blank page of a paper wrapper or flyleaf, with handwritten pencil notes in the centre and upper left; a fragment of a printed title page visible at the far right edge (cut off by the scan, not transcribed); digitiser's credit line at the foot.
page.notes: Blank page. Handwriting only: "BIBLE: concordance" in pencil, with "G.S.P" and "4/53" below it, and a number "854" with a stroke at the upper left, with pencil marks along the left edge. These are manuscript annotations, not printed text, and are not transcribed. The right edge shows part of a printed title page (fragment of "TH..." heading and small lines) lying on the neighbouring page, which is show-through/edge and is not transcribed. The footer "Early European Books, Copyright 2011 ProQuest LLC. Images reproduced by courtesy of The Wellcome Trust, London. 854/A" is the digitiser's credit and is excluded.
